ass:cmh-recovery-envelope: Seek a regular moment-map approximation of every centered log-concave law with a dimension-free CMH bound.
ass:tight-prefix-carleson: Control the accumulated localization source by time, the remainder, and an absorbable share of damping.
ass:weighted-package: The historical covariance-weighted estimate for near-minimizing cuts; its universal claim was refuted.
cert:ambient-intrinsic-comparison: Package equality of ambient and intrinsic relaxed energies and Poincaré constants.
cert:binary-tensorization: Bound the Poincaré constant of two independent factors by the larger factor constant.
cert:finite-tensorization: Identify the constant of a finite independent product with the supremum of its factor constants, including degenerate cases.
cert:gaussian-one-dimensional: Identify a one-dimensional Gaussian's optimal Poincaré constant with its variance, including zero variance.
cert:legacy-relaxed-comparison: Transfer smooth-test bounds to relaxed-energy constants; this certificate does not identify Cheeger energy.
cert:linear-test-lower: Use linear tests to bound the Poincaré constant below by the largest covariance eigenvalue.
conj:kls: Seek one dimension-free Poincaré bound for all isotropic log-concave laws, equivalently a covariance-scaled bound.
cor:absolutely-continuous-relaxation-two: Identify canonical energy with twice Cheeger energy when the intrinsic law has a density, including log-concave laws.
cor:ambient-intrinsic-constant-equality: Show that ambient and intrinsic relaxed energies have the same optimal Poincaré constant, including infinity.
cor:cmh-recovery-sequence-suffices: Deduce KLS if every centered log-concave law has a regular recovery sequence with a universal CMH bound.
cor:conditional-fiber-twelve-bound: For full-dimensional log-concave laws, bound fiber energy by four times gradient energy; the historical ID retains “twelve”.
cor:tight-window-consumption: Turn the assumed tight-prefix estimate into a dimension-free boundary bound and then KLS.
def:affine-poincare-constant: Define the affine Poincaré constant using relaxed covariance-weighted gradient energy on the affine support.
def:affine-support-intrinsic-law: Describe the smallest affine space carrying the law and its probability distribution in intrinsic coordinates.
def:conditional-fiber-form: Define energy by averaging conditional variances along lines, normalized by each fiber's coordinate variance.
def:extended-energy: Define an energy that may be infinite and the domain where it is finite.
def:intrinsic-affine-energy: Transport relaxed smooth-gradient energy from intrinsic coordinates back to ambient L² classes.
def:isoperimetric-cheeger-scale: Define the Cheeger constant from boundary expansion relative to the smaller mass, and define its reciprocal scale.
def:isotropic-law: Define an isotropic law as centered with identity covariance, including the zero-dimensional case.
def:l2-energy-poincare-constant: Define the optimal variance-to-energy constant for an extended energy on L².
def:l2-mean-variance: Define mean, centering, and variance independently of the representative of an L² class.
def:legacy-smooth-test-poincare: Define the Poincaré inequality and its optimal constant using globally smooth tests with finite gradient energy.
def:literature-poincare-constant: Define the literature Poincaré constant using locally Lipschitz tests and local slopes on the affine support.
def:log-concave-law: Define log-concavity by the mass inequality for convex combinations of compact sets, allowing lower-dimensional support.
def:poincare-test-family: Define variance-to-energy quotients and their optimal bound on a specified test domain, with zero-energy conventions.
def:preenergy-relaxation: Extend a test energy by taking the least limiting energy among convergent test sequences.
def:selected-canonical-frontend: Choose intrinsic relaxed smooth-gradient energy as the canonical energy and define its Poincaré constant.
def:smooth-gradient-preenergy: Assign each admissible smooth function the integral of its squared gradient.
def:smooth-gradient-relaxation: Extend smooth-gradient energy to L² by sequential relaxation.
lem:affine-poincare-translation-invarian: Show that translating a log-concave law preserves log-concavity and its affine Poincaré constant.
lem:ambient-intrinsic-covariance: Identify ambient covariance with intrinsic covariance on the support and zero on normal directions, preserving the operator norm.
lem:conditional-fiber-energy-comparison: Turn an assumed fiber Poincaré bound with coefficient κ into a gradient-energy comparison and a κC global bound.
lem:conditional-fiber-form: Establish closed quadratic and Markov properties of the conditional-fiber energy under the stated density and moment assumptions.
lem:covariance-core-closure: Close the transformed gradient operator and identify its Lipschitz and smooth-core closures for log-concave densities.
lem:covariance-test-core-density: Approximate locally Lipschitz tests and their transformed gradients by compactly supported smooth tests under absolute continuity.
lem:finite-energy-factor-poincare: Transfer a Poincaré bound between energies when one is bounded by a finite multiple of the other.
lem:logconcave-intrinsic-absolute-contin: Show that a log-concave law has a density in its intrinsic affine space, even if singular in the ambient space.
lem:mutual-test-approximation-relaxation: Identify two relaxed energies when each test family approximates the other without increasing limiting energy.
lem:preenergy-poincare-relaxation: Show that sequential relaxation preserves valid Poincaré bounds and the optimal constant.
lem:relative-perimeter-cheeger-infimum: Identify the Cheeger infimum over Borel sets with the weighted-perimeter infimum over smooth domains.
lem:relative-perimeter-smoothing: Approximate a smooth-domain indicator by smooth Lipschitz functions whose limiting gradient integral is at most its perimeter.
lem:smooth-tests-affine-restriction-exte: Restrict smooth tests to the affine support and extend intrinsic tests back while controlling gradient energy.
obs:dirac-raw-energy: Exhibit two functions equal for a Dirac law whose raw gradient energies differ, explaining the need for relaxation.
obs:normal-direction-raw-energy: Show that a function vanishing on the affine support can still have positive ambient gradient energy in a normal direction.
prop:spectral-sufficiency: Deduce a dimension-free Poincaré bound from the assumed full-damping occupation estimate.
prop:weighted-spectator-obstruction: Use independent exponential factors to refute the historical weighted package, without refuting KLS.
q:conditional-fiber-frame: Seek a frame independent of the test function that controls variance by fiber energy with a universal constant.
q:mm-spectral-occupation: Seek a universal-time source estimate for a fixed eigenfunction along localization, uniform through regular approximation.
q:smooth-gradient-raw-core-agreement: Determine when raw energy descends to L² and how sequential approximation relates to graph-norm density.
thm:affine-covariance-relaxation-closed: Identify the relaxed covariance energy of a log-concave law with the closed affine form used by the CMH route.
thm:affine-isotropic-reduction: Show that isotropic, covariance-scaled, and affine-energy KLS bounds are equivalent, including lower-dimensional laws.
thm:ambient-intrinsic-relaxation-equalit: Show that ambient and intrinsic smooth-gradient relaxations agree on the same L² space.
thm:borell-logconcave-density: Represent a log-concave law by an intrinsic log-concave density, positive with locally bounded reciprocal inside its convex support.
thm:cmh-recovery-affine-poincare-bound: Bound the affine Poincaré constant of a W₂ limit by the limiting CMH constants of a regular recovery sequence.
thm:compact-borell-logconcavity-equivale: Show that compact-set log-concavity is equivalent to the Borel-set formulation using inner measure.
thm:intrinsic-affine-constant-order: Characterize a valid intrinsic-affine Poincaré bound by comparison with the optimal extended constant.
thm:intrinsic-affine-energy-closed: Establish that intrinsic relaxed energy is a densely defined closed quadratic energy on ambient L².
thm:intrinsic-l2-equivalence: Identify ambient and intrinsic L² spaces by inverse linear isometries.
thm:klartag-density-frontend-identificat: Identify the intrinsic Cheeger constant with the smooth-boundary density formulation for non-Dirac log-concave laws.
thm:l2-energy-holds-order: Show that an L² energy inequality holds at a finite constant exactly when the optimal constant is no larger.
thm:legacy-canonical-constant-comparison: Identify the smooth-test, ambient relaxed, and canonical intrinsic Poincaré constants.
thm:legacy-relaxed-holds-equivalence: Show that smooth tests and ambient relaxed energy admit exactly the same finite Poincaré bounds.
thm:logconcave-cheeger-poincare-comparis: Compare Poincaré and inverse-Cheeger scales in both directions for log-concave laws, with factors 4 and π.
thm:one-dimensional-logconcave-poincare: Bound a one-dimensional log-concave law's Poincaré constant by four times its variance, including zero variance.
thm:quadratic-relaxation-closed: Show that relaxing a quadratic pre-energy with dense linear realization gives a closed quadratic form.
thm:selected-literature-constant-equival: Identify canonical and local-slope Poincaré constants for finite-dimensional log-concave laws.
thm:smooth-gradient-quadratic-dense: Show that smooth-gradient pre-energy is quadratic and its test realizations are dense in L².
thm:smooth-gradient-raw-core-agreement-d: Under explicit positive-density and local reciprocal bounds, identify intrinsic raw energy with its relaxation on the smooth core.
thm:smooth-gradient-relaxation-closed: Establish closed quadratic structure and a dense finite-energy domain for ambient relaxed gradient energy.
thm:smooth-gradient-relaxation-dirichlet: Show that normal contractions decrease relaxed gradient energy, giving the ambient and intrinsic energies the Dirichlet property.
thm:smooth-gradient-relaxation-two-cheeg: Seek identification of canonical energy with twice metric Cheeger energy for general laws, beyond the proved density case.
thm:smooth-lipschitz-constant-equivalenc: Identify smooth-test and locally Lipschitz Poincaré constants when the intrinsic law is absolutely continuous.
